cases.name: source-generated-boundary
cases.description: The documentation workflow edits source and regenerates owned artifacts.
cases.prompt: A package contributor manually edited an .Rd file and a rendered site page to fix documentation. Recommend the correct workflow.
traps: Keeps the manual edits as the source of truth
Does not rebuild or review generated output

assertions.text: Changes roxygen2, vignette, Quarto, R Markdown, or book source rather than generated output.
Regenerates documentation and reviews links, warnings, and rendered output.
Keeps generated artifacts reproducible from a clean session.

cases.name: reproducible-examples
cases.description: Examples expose their inputs and dependencies and can be rerun by another reader.
cases.prompt: Design a vignette example that uses randomness, an optional package, and a rendered plot. What should the documentation make explicit?
traps: Relies on the author's current session or random seed
Makes an optional dependency silently required

assertions.text: Uses a deterministic seed or records inputs when output is intended to be reproducible.
Declares or guards documentation-only and optional dependencies.
Keeps reusable logic outside report chunks when appropriate.
